note: Round 7, from the same team catalog file as round 6 (20 Nov; 83 live products, 57 with a price and a capacity figure). New duplicate rule (Kevin, 22 Nov, #230): a second slot of the same drink adds capacity only, never demand, so project.py no longer credits it with 75% more sales. Under that rule no drink sells out between Friday refills in the base case, so the maths gives 20 distinct drinks, with no hard rule against duplicates. One slot is the test slot, which rotates a new drink every week; on day one it holds the best drink from a category no other slot stocks. The agent still picks the wildcard. The $366 cap is what limits the mix: cheap bubly 8-packs and Arizona replace plan 6's second Red Bull, Snapple, Gatorade and Powerade slots. Placement follows the fall data by position (all 40 selections, before the cut), as in round 6; the projection has no position effect.
